description:
Team TAARA (GIKI Topi, Pakistan) unites physicists, electronics engineers & designers to build an SI-powered dashboard that ranks and interprets NASA PSI microgravity combustion data for Moon/Mars fire safety.

summary: TAARA is an interactive analytics dashboard that transforms complex NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) microgravity combustion datasets into actionable fire-safety intelligence for future Lunar and Martian habitats. By ranking material flammability, ignition behaviors, and flame dynamics in reduced gravity, our platform helps mission engineers mitigate fire risks before human crews leave Earth.
details:
The Challenge Fire behaves unpredictably in microgravity and partial-gravity environments (such as the Moon at 1/6g and Mars at 3/8g). Without Earth's buoyancy-driven convection, flames spread differently, linger invisibly, and produce hazardous combustion byproducts-posing one of the greatest threats to crewed deep-space missions. While NASA’s Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) repository houses decades of invaluable experimental data, researchers and engineers need an intuitive way to cross-compare datasets and translate raw experimental records into habitat safety decisions.

Our Solution Built by Team TAARA (GIKI), Flame in Freefall is a web-based analytical dashboard designed to parse, validate, rank, and interpret NASA microgravity combustion experiments:

  • Verified PSI Data Engine: Audits and structures experimental records spanning PSI-98 through PSI-181 (including microgravity solder joint evaluations and solid/liquid fuel combustion studies) using automated validation pipelines (validate_psi.py and verified_psi.json).
  • Risk Ranking & Comparative Scoring: Evaluates materials and experimental conditions across key combustion parameters to highlight high-risk fire scenarios and safer material alternatives.
  • Moon & Mars Habitat Translation: Bridges orbital ISS microgravity findings with partial-gravity operational constraints, providing clear fire-prevention and suppression insights for Lunar Gateway, Artemis surface habitats, and Mars transit vehicles.
  • Interactive Visual Interface: Features a custom space-themed dashboard (app.py) allowing engineers and students to filter experiments, inspect metadata, and compare flame behavior across multiple PSI investigations in seconds.

Tech Stack Python, Streamlit / interactive web dashboard (app.py), JSON data validation pipelines, custom visual assets, and NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) open data.

Super Intelligence (Google Gemini, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and chatgpt) was utilized to assist with data structuring, code debugging, UI/documentation drafting, and in-app dataset interpretation. Gemini was integrated into App for AI-Integration.
